params.body:
Phase 2 of `docs/content-architectuur.md`: the articles written in the Studio's *Blog* appear on hoet.be, as *Nieuws*, following the choices in §0b (#85).

## What a visitor sees

- **Overview** at `/{lang}/blog`, with the categories as text links when there is more than one, and a page per category at `/{lang}/blog/categorie/{slug}`.
- **The article** at `/{lang}/blog/{slug}`: category, title, date, reading time, the hero, and the body with every block the Studio offers: text with headings, lists and links (internal links follow the slug in each language), image (column, wide or full width, with a srcset; a portrait photo stops at the height of the window), gallery, own film (the same player as the film on the home), YouTube or Vimeo, quote, frame card and button.
- **Linked frames** as the collection-page cards under the article, and *Meer nieuws*: three others, same category first. The frame pages do not point back to articles.
- **Nieuws** in the main menu (after Collecties) and the footer, and the three newest articles on the home above the production film. Only when the switch *Nieuws tonen* is on in the Studio (hoet-sanity, proposed alongside) and at least one article is listed.

## The rules (`App\Support\Journal`, §6.2)

- A language exists only with title, slug and body in it; half a translation stays off. The language switch sends a missing language to that language's overview.
- **Scheduling** needs no clock: an article with a future date is a 404 until the minute it is due, then it is live without a sync.
- **Old addresses**: a new table `journal_slugs`, kept by `sanity:sync`. A renamed slug gives a 301, an unpublished article a 410 (new `errors/410` page), the slug of another language a 301 to this language's.
- *Niet in zoekmachines*: the article keeps its address with `noindex`, and stays out of the overview, the home, the sitemap and *Meer nieuws*.
- A linked frame that is inactive or unpublished drops out; an internal link to something offline keeps its text, loses the link, and is logged.

## Search and privacy

- `BlogPosting` JSON-LD with the brand as author and publisher (the existing `Organization` by `@id`), the hero in 16:9, 4:3 and 1:1, `about` from the linked frames, `VideoObject` for films; `og:type=article` with the `article:` tags; breadcrumbs.
- Articles in the sitemap, dated by *Inhoudelijk bijgewerkt*, else the publication date, never `_updatedAt`.
- YouTube and Vimeo load only on a click (`youtube-nocookie.com`, Vimeo with `dnt=1`), behind our own still, with a line saying where the film comes from. `frame-src` gets those two hosts and nothing else.

## Editors

The Studio's *Voorbeeld* button opens `/{lang}/blog/preview/{id}`: behind the site's admin login, read live from Sanity (drafts included), `noindex` and `Cache-Control: no-store`, with a bar *Voorbeeld, niet gepubliceerd*.

## Also

`sanity:sync` hourly in the scheduler (`withoutOverlapping`), so a missed webhook is caught within the hour. On 13 October 2026 a revoked token kept the mirror stale while every publish looked fine. If Forge already has a cron line or deploy step running `sanity:sync`, one of the two can go.

## Deploy

One migration (`journal_slugs`). The menu stays as it is until the switch is on in the Studio.

## Tests

`BlogTest` (15: live article and its schema, scheduling with `travel`, half translation, other-language slug, renamed and unpublished slugs, noindex, sitemap date, menu and footer on/off/empty, home strip position, frame cards one way, preview access and headers, embed without iframe, offline link, related) and `ArtikelBlokkenTest` (the site knows exactly the members in `tests/fixtures/article-body-members.json`, the same file as in hoet-sanity, and each renders; an unknown block renders nothing and is logged; numbered and bullet lists). Full suite 432/433: the one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which needs a deployed checkout and passes in CI. Pint and PHPStan clean. Checked in a browser on desktop and phone width with a sample article holding every block.
params.title: Put the blog on the site, as Nieuws
